name: Aqua-Terrarium 50x35x45x25
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Combined aqua-terrarium measuring 50x35x45 cm. Ideal for animals that need both a land and a water section in their habitat. Water section height: 25 cm.

description.html: A floor of 50x35 cm makes this the smallest aqua-terrarium we build as a standard size. Water is filled to 25 cm, which gives about 44 liters, and above it 20 cm remains for an island, a lamp and air. That amount of water suits young aquatic turtles and smaller amphibians, while an adult red-eared slider needs a considerably larger pool.

Thanks to its small outer dimensions it can stand on a stable dresser or a desk, bearing in mind that the water alone weighs about 44 kg. Over half a meter of length, the heat lamp goes above the land area at one end, and the opposite end of the water stays cooler. With a volume this small the water gets dirty faster, so plan for a filter and more frequent water changes.
The 78.8 liters of total volume, of which about 44 liters is water, hold juveniles of these groups:

items: Amphibians that need an aquatic section

description.html: When the turtle outgrows these 50 cm, the next steps in our range are the 60x35x45 and 80x45x50 aqua-terrariums with water up to 30 cm. We can also build this model with a different water section height if you keep amphibians that need more land. A build to your dimensions takes 7 to 14 days. We cut and glue the glass by hand in Novi Sad, and the outer film is chosen from 34 patterns.
